selectedProgram.selectionRule: unique subshader 0 / pass 0 HGBuffer / SourceSubProgramIndex 19 / EndfieldD3D11 pair whose compiled keywords are exactly HG_ENABLE_MV and _PARALLAX_MAP

vertexContract.behavior: optional skinning; current and previous object/world/clip positions; world normal and tangent; vertex color; UV0/UV1; current and previous screen positions for motion

inputs: TEXCOORD0 through TEXCOORD6 from the selected vertex program

constantBuffers.b1: ShaderVariablesGlobal, selected 106 registers / 1696 bytes; screen, global mip, exposure, VFX anchor/time/brightness reads
constantBuffers.b2: UnityPerDraw, selected 5 registers / 80 bytes; renderer LOD/fade/motion state
constantBuffers.b3: UnityPerMaterial, selected 31 registers / 496 bytes within recovered named 576-byte layout

outputs.SV_Target0: SceneColor: parallax HDR emission RGB, alpha 0.5
outputs.SV_Target1: SceneMV: encoded motion xy, model flag z, TAAU normal scalar w
outputs.SV_Target2: GBufferA: roughness, occlusion, zero, terrain profile high bits
outputs.SV_Target3: GBufferB: octahedral world normal xy, metallic remap z, terrain profile low bits w

fragmentContract.depth: writable SceneDepth attachment selected by pass state; fragment has no SV_Depth output

implementationDecision.reason: The selected binaries and material layout are sufficient to identify the retail program, but not to publish its engine-owned frame/per-draw inputs. A Unity source port would have to invent or zero those inputs and therefore would be a visual approximation, not a source-exact consumer.
implementationDecision.firstSourceProvenMismatch: fragment b1 reads ShaderVariablesGlobal c105.z/w, the live HGVFXManager.GetAnchorWaveBright output, while the recovery lab has no validated publisher or captured selected-frame values for those registers
implementationDecision.compileTest: not applicable: no misleading shader source was emitted
